description: This file defines the `TableSwitch` class, a UI component that extends `Table` representing a switch-type configuration in a ROM tuning application. It handles UI elements like radio buttons to select switch states, manages switch state data, and performs data validation and persistence within the application.

classes.name: TableSwitch
classes.description: A UI component representing a switch type table in a ROM tuning context, capable of displaying switch states, validating data, and persisting user selections.

methods.name: populateTable
methods.description: Builds the switch UI with radio buttons for each switch state and validates against ROM data.

methods.name: saveFile
methods.description: Saves the selected switch state into the provided byte array if not locked.

methods.name: setValues
methods.description: Associates a switch state name with its byte value.

methods.name: getValues
methods.description: Retrieves the byte value associated with a switch state name.

methods.name: getButtonGroup
methods.description: Returns the button group containing switching options.

methods.name: getSwitchStates
methods.description: Returns the mapping of switch state names to their byte values.

methods.name: getType
